scientific_integrity: Conditional variance formula and hypergeometric rarefaction framework are established in Nipperess and Matsen (arXiv:1208.6552). The added claim concerns five-tip root-topology classification and exact double-peak phase inequalities; literature equivalence remains a residual risk. Mathematical identities verified by independently formulated exact rational subset computations; no independent external scientific audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact conditional rooted Faith-PD variance under uniform fixed-size sampling without replacement from rooted full binary strictly ultrametric trees with at most five distinct taxa; not established for larger trees, non-ultrametric or unrooted trees, repeated draws or estimator variance.
title: Two rarefaction-variance peaks require a two-versus-three root split on five ultrametric taxa
